name: graphori
description: Plan coding work, use only useful agents, and check the result.

interface.shortDescription: Plan the work, use only useful agents, and check the result.
interface.longDescription: Graphori turns a coding task into ordered steps, delegates only where another agent helps, and records the checks used to judge completion.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $graphori to plan, implement, and verify this task end to end.
